description: This file defines the Perl module Git::SVN::GlobSpec, which provides functionality to create and manage glob pattern objects for matching filesystem paths with specific wildcard and pattern rules. It includes methods for constructing glob pattern objects and obtaining full paths based on a base glob pattern.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A class representing a glob pattern, supporting pattern matching with wildcards and placeholders for filesystem paths.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new GlobSpec object, parsing the glob pattern and compiling it into a regex.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Returns the full path by combining the base parts with a provided relative path.
